cases.name: Shawna Michelle Judd Smith
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Shawna was a devoted mother who loved children, especially her children. She was the Pre-school Director at Busy Bee Day Care. She was a loving, classy, beautiful person inside and out. She enjoyed arts and crafts. She loved her family more than anything else."

"Shawna is a wonderful, loving mother. She's my daughter and she's my heart. And my babies … they didn't deserve this, they didn't deserve this," an emotional Sheila Pruitt, Shawna Smith's mother, said in tears.
